decisive_items: novel heterozygous missense variant, c.6832G>T, p.Gly2278Trp, in COL7A1 (NM_000094)
response.rationale: Only R3 is supplied. Its raw support spans directly establish subepidermal separation and a pathogenic COL7A1 missense variant, together definitive for dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa. No competing candidate was provided for contrast.
